repeated_tail_diagnostic.note: Descriptive exact text repetition proxy, not an entropy measurement or a complete measure of semantic repetition.

map_readout_diagnostic.policy: Deterministic smallest learned candidate distance, excluding visited nodes; true shortest distances used only to score paths.
map_readout_diagnostic.note: Read-only map-quality diagnostic, not an additional sampled LLM condition.

case_studies.selection: Illustrative positive, generation-failure, and local-ranking cases; not a random sample.
case_studies.true_distances: Computed from the saved prompt adjacency for post-hoc analysis only; never provided to the model.
